cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Over dinner you keep saying you're managing. What's hard about going home?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The silence. I leave the television on so it sounds occupied.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Could you ask me over instead of pretending you've got company?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cook. I promise I won't be miserable all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you invite me without that promise? I'd like to come even if you're miserable and we eat toast.

mechanism: A grants company without entertainment conditions, directing B to drop a competent-host performance and ask for support plainly.
confusable: D73 seeks B presence for A; D108 asks B to lower their own guard and admit what affects them.
comparison: A lonely home with television company differs from a closed shop and practiced morale smile.
seedUse: Use D108-b TV silence coping and B promised meal/no-misery offer, which must cause refusal of the performance condition.
